_doc: Compatibility knowledge for panel indicators. Gnotch discovers indicators at run time from Main.panel.statusArea; this file only adds human names, the owning extension and an honest status. Anything not matched here is still tried generically and shown as 'unidentified'. Edit via docs/compatibility-extensions.md.

replaced.activities: Not shown. Press Super to open the Overview.
replaced.quickSettings: Its real menu is embedded in the expanded notch (System page).

tilingshell@ferrarodomenico.com.note: Panel indicator is embedded in the notch and keeps its own menu.

ubuntu-appindicators@ubuntu.com.note: Tray icons are embedded as they appear.

ubuntu-dock@ubuntu.com.note: Has no panel indicator. Independent of the panel.

just-perfection-desktop@just-perfection.note: Panel visibility options of Just Perfection are overridden while Gnotch is active; Gnotch restores the panel when disabled.

blur-my-shell@aunetx.note: Panel blur applies to the hidden panel and has no effect on the notch.

user-theme@gnome-shell-extensions.gcampa.note: Shell theme; the notch uses its own black surface.

vertical-workspaces@G-dH.github.com.note: Replaces the Overview and parts of the panel; not enabled on the development machine, so not verified.
